Jordan (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — opening a short live Q&A for hybrid/office travel, offsites, and special cases (compassionate travel, climate offsets, illness policies). Post one-line Qs and we'll reply. I'll fold clarifications into the Workstyle playbook. https://intranet.redwood/workstyle :seedling:

Sofie Tran: Do we reimburse carbon offsets for flights? If so, how do I claim them?

Jordan (People Ops): Good Q. We offer an opt-in green travel reimbursement: up to $50 per round-trip flight (attach offset receipt + tag `green-offset`). If your team chooses a fully offset team booking, people-ops can coordinate a bulk offset and bill central travel. For offsets bought on top of tickets, submit as `green-offset` within 30 days.

Marcus Li: If there's a family emergency and I need to rebook last-minute, what counts as covered compassionate travel? Can I use upgrades (e.g., extra legroom) if needed?

Jordan (People Ops): Compassionate travel covers unexpected family/medical emergencies. Process: 1) Book what's available, 2) get manager to confirm emergency via a short Slack DM or email, 3) submit expense with tag `compassionate-travel`. We reimburse reasonable upgrades if they are medically necessary or reduce risk (e.g., required seat for health reasons). People Ops will fast-track approval.

Priya Rao: What's the policy if someone gets sick during an offsite? Do we cover extra nights / isolation hotel?

Jordan (People Ops): We have an offsite illness flow: if you fall ill, first notify onsite lead + people-ops. We can book an isolation room (company-paid) and cover additional nights + reasonable medical taxis. Travel insurance is primary for medical evacuation; people-ops assists with claims. Tag expenses `offsite-illness` and keep receipts.

Sofie Tran: Any guidance on choosing verified offset vendors? I want to make sure it's compliant.

Jordan (People Ops): Use the vendor list in the playbook (we pre-approved three providers). If you use a non-listed vendor, include vendor docs and we'll review. For team-wide offsets we prefer consolidated purchases so accounting can track.

GreenTravelBot: Notice: Green travel reimbursement policy updated 2026-11-01. See: https://intranet.redwood/policies/green-travel (automated).

Marcus Li: Expense example I can paste into Concur?

Jordan (People Ops): Sure, copy/paste below into the notes section or your expense description:

```
Expense title: LHR-SFO-Offsite-Flight
Amount: 642.00
Category: Travel - Flight
Receipt: flight.pdf
Tag: offsite-may-2026
Optional: green-offset $20 (provider: GoodAirOffsets)
```

Jordan (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll pin this and add to the Workstyle FAQ. For fast help with visa letters, compassionate approvals, or bulk offsets, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com :spiral_note_pad:
